news.title: AACTE releases national framework on AI in educator preparation
news.summary_en: A new national framework from AACTE (American Association of Colleges for Teacher Education) aims to help educator preparation programs (EPPs) navigate the rapidly changing role of artificial intelligence in education.

news.title: Choose encouragement before negativity sets the tone
news.summary_en: Negativity can take hold quickly in higher education. It can surface in a faculty meeting, a hallway conversation, an email exchange, or in an informal discussion after a presentation.
